title: Nack Message
help: Negatively acknowledge a message received by the inbound endpoint (target INBOUND, the default) or a message polled with ackMode CLIENT (target POLL). FAILED asks the broker to redeliver, REJECTED moves the message to the dead message queue. The inbound endpoint must run with solace.autoAck=false.

value.name: outcomeType
value.helpTip: FAILED: broker redelivers the message (subject to max-redelivery, then DMQ if configured). REJECTED: broker routes immediately to DMQ, otherwise discards. Inbound endpoint must declare required settlement outcomes for this to work.

value.name: target
value.helpTip: INBOUND settles the inbound endpoint's message through its settlement handle. POLL settles the message stashed by a poll with ackMode=CLIENT.

value.name: responseVariable
value.helpTip: Property name where the operation result is stored.

value.name: overwriteBody
value.helpTip: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.
